description: This file defines the 'registry' class responsible for registering SOAP complex types and service functions for SuiteCRM's web service API. It includes method definitions for registering functions and complex data types used in the web services such as user authentication, entries, relationships, modules, and document revisions.

classes.name: registry
classes.description: A class that manages registration of SOAP functions and complex types for SuiteCRM web services.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Calls registration functions for all SOAP methods and types.

methods.name: registerFunction
methods.description: Registers individual SOAP functions with their parameters and return types.

methods.name: registerTypes
methods.description: Registers complex data types used in SOAP methods.
